title: Policy Form Provisions on Ending a Medicare Supplement Policy: Free Look, Notice, Unearned Premium and the Birthday Switch
content:
A policy issued under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies carries four terms governing how it may be brought to an end and how premium already paid is treated: the calendar days from delivery within which the policy may be returned for a full refund, the calendar days of notice the policyholder gives to cancel later, the basis on which premium paid beyond the termination date is worked out and returned, and whether and within how many days around their birthday the policyholder may move to an equal or lesser plan without health questions.

| Policy | Free look period, calendar days | Notice to cancel, calendar days | Unearned premium returned on this basis | Birthday switch | Birthday window, calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | permitted | 63 |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 30 | 30 | premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination | not permitted | 0 |

### Where the letters differ and where they do not

The free look period is 30 calendar days on every letter, the notice to cancel 30 calendar days on every letter, and the unearned premium basis the same sentence on every letter: premium paid beyond the termination date returned in whole months, counted from the first day of the month after termination.

The birthday switch is the single term on which the letters part. It is permitted on Plan A, Plan B, Plan D, Plan K, Plan N and Plan G, each with a window of 63 calendar days around the policyholder's birthday. It is not permitted on High Deductible Plan G, whose window stands at 0.
